properties.name: Status Ecclesiasticus
properties.linkNote: The Papacy is an institution in the Codex, not a territory. The polygon is the temporal state it governed.

properties.name: Imperium Romanum Orientale
properties.linkNote: The source names it as contemporaries did — the Eastern Roman Empire. 'Byzantine' is a later historians' label for the same state.

properties.name: امپراتوری سلجوقی
properties.linkNote: The Codex article is the Great Seljuk Empire (1037–1194).
